Original method: https://github.com/MZehren/ADTOF
This pinned repository did not contain a LICENSE file. Public redistribution clearance remains unverified; this is a local personal-use RC.
XLD adapter: strict state loading after hash verification, 30-second inference blocks with 5-second context, global peak picking; fixed velocity 100 and five GM drum keys 35/38/47/42/49. Same-key hit durations are clipped to the next onset for MIDI roundtrip compatibility. No onset quantization.
